implement_UnifiedQuest3CameraInterface: implement a subclass of UnifiedQuest3CameraInterface that provides concrete methods for Quest 3 camera data retrieval
get_rgb_frames: use get_rgb to retrieve the latest RGB image frame as a numpy array from the Quest 3 camera
get_depth_maps: use get_depth to retrieve the latest depth map as a numpy array from the Quest 3 depth sensor
get_camera_intrinsics: use get_rbg_focal_lengths and get_rgb_principal_point to retrieve RGB camera intrinsic parameters
get_camera_poses: use get_deviceWorld_T_rgbCamera to retrieve the SE3 pose of the RGB camera in the device world frame
